# American Pharmacogenomics Association

> The American Pharmacogenomics Association (APGxA) is a professional organization connecting pharmacogenomics leaders, researchers, and healthcare professionals to advance personalized medicine through education, collaboration, and community engagement.

APGxA serves as the central hub for the pharmacogenomics community, offering membership, professional training, AI-powered tools, and evidence-based resources to promote the integration of genetic testing and personalized medicine into clinical practice. The organization combines educational programs, expert guidance, and community screening initiatives to drive adoption of pharmacogenomics in healthcare.

## Key Topics

- Pharmacogenomics
- Personalized Medicine
